breakdown.description: The global horizontal traction on the left slope is reinterpreted as slope-aligned tangential shear
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly reinterpreted a horizontal traction (σ_xx=6000 Pa) as a 'tangential shear traction'. The ground truth corrected this by specifying 'apply the horizontal traction'. The agent's generated specification incorrectly states 'A tangential shear traction... is applied', thus repeating the user's error instead of fixing it.
